Questions.

Where does the CA live?

Held inside a fixed strip above everything else. While unannounced, the strip says as much and ignores clicks. After announcement it prints the whole string and copies using a single tap.

Why does the board list other tokens?

Context helps. Put Velius next to whatever the crowd is chasing, no tab switching required.

What happens when the feed fails?

The board keeps its last good numbers and tries again with growing pauses. If it never had numbers, you see dashes and an error line instead of invented values.

Is there a team page?

The whitepaper holds a placeholder for it. Names get added only when they are confirmed.
